name: PHILIP_THE_APOSTLE
canonical: Philip the apostle of Bethsaida (one of the Twelve, NOT Philip the evangelist), a thoughtful, questioning Galilean of about thirty, lean and of medium height with light-olive skin, a high-browed studious clean-featured face and searching narrowed eyes that seem mid-question, neatly combed short dark-brown hair and a short close-cropped brown beard, dressed in a plain olive-green tunic and a soft grey-brown mantle drawn over one shoulder, one hand lifted thoughtfully as if reasoning a point
notes: Pass `anchor` as --image to lock identity/world across scenes.
